evidence_gaps_proposed: No independently adjudicated advanced EGFR-mutant NSCLC evidence-retrieval benchmark with prior therapy, treatment line, date, jurisdiction and contradictions was established by this bounded search.

Multi-system comparisons found are pan-cancer: LLM evidence-level assignment (Lin et al. 2025) and literature ranking for cancer-gene-treatment topics (TREC 2020 PM, two EGFR topics); neither prints an EGFR-only score.
TREC 2020 PM per-topic scores for the EGFR topics are shown only in run-appendix figures, and NIST per-run summary files need participant credentials.
LLM evidence-level accuracy may be inflated by training-data exposure to the public OncoKB and CIViC tables (Lin et al. 2025 Discussion).
No multi-system comparison of retrieving resistance evidence (for example T790M, C797S, MET amplification) after progression on an EGFR inhibitor was found.
exclusions_proposed: Evidence retrieval does not select a treatment or establish individual treatment benefit.
Trial eligibility, response and survival require separate evaluations.
Missing evidence does not establish resistance, and evidence tiers from different systems are not interchangeable.
LLM treatment-recommendation concordance studies (for example against NCCN guidelines or tumour boards) answer treatment selection, not evidence retrieval.

summary_proposal.value: Two sources add multi-system comparisons on precision-oncology evidence tasks; neither is specific to EGFR-mutant NSCLC after targeted therapy, and neither tests treatment choice or patient benefit. Lin et al. 2025 asked GPT-4o, Llama 3.1 and Qwen 2.5 to assign knowledge-base evidence levels to gene, alteration and tumour-type queries. Top-1 accuracy in assigning OncoKB levels, which include the resistance levels R1 and R2, was 0.3393, 0.3066 and 0.3328; for CIViC levels it was 0.1865, 0.1212 and 0.2485. Separating clinically relevant variants from VUS in 10,506 FoundationOne report variants reached 0.7318 for GPT-4o; a refined prompt raised Qwen 2.5 from 0.5731 to 0.7246, and retrieval augmentation to 0.6616. The authors note that the public OncoKB and CIViC tables may be in the models' training data. In the TREC 2020 Precision Medicine track, systems ranked MEDLINE abstracts for 40 cancer-gene-treatment topics, two of them EGFR-mutant NSCLC. The best runs per team printed in the overview reached infNDCG 0.5325 (a tuned BM25 baseline) and 0.5303 (BioBERT re-ranking) for topical relevance. For evidence-tier-weighted ranking, the top printed run (0.4780 NDCG@30) was a manual run with human-in-the-loop active learning, and the best automatic run printed reached 0.4238. Only the top five teams per metric are printed, per-topic EGFR scores are not tabulated, and the 2019 MEDLINE snapshot and topics carry no prior-therapy or resistance context. No source measures retrieval of source-linked resistance evidence after progression on an EGFR inhibitor.

vocabulary_changes.reason: TREC 2020 PM reports P@10 and R-prec; only precision-at-100 existed. Both are narrower than precision, direction higher, no external match added.

not_extracted.reason: All-run and per-topic scores are figures only.

The NIST browser lists summary scores for every run; only the overview's printed tables were extracted to keep the batch lean. The browser values were used to check Tables 5-6 (every infNDCG and P@10 cell matches; R-prec is not listed there).
Per-level confusion and stability analyses not extracted.

gaps: Jun et al. 2026 Cancer Cell (MOAlmanac RAG vs LLM-only, includes a CIViC-augmented variant): per-system values in figures and a supplementary PDF not retrieved; licence is author-manuscript TDM only.
Hisch and Wang 2024 (arXiv:2407.04466): CIViC evidence-level labelling of abstracts by fine-tuned encoders and GPT-4; not extracted (20-item GPT-4 test set, internal table inconsistency).
VICC meta-knowledgebase (Wagner et al. 2020): knowledgebase match rates on patient cohorts in figures only.
Three commercial decision-support platforms (ESMO Open 2020): concordance in prose and figures only.
OncoKB redistribution and AI training terms (recorded in the 2026-10-07 dossier) unchanged; no OncoKB data are copied here.
